name: Replicate
tagline: Run open and custom AI models through an API, billed by use
description: Replicate lets developers run public and private machine-learning models through an API and pay as they go, by run time, output or tokens.
features: Per-output pricing for many image, video and language models
useCases: Adding image, video or language models to an app
Running custom or fine-tuned models without managing servers
strengths: Pay-per-use billing; the page says you only pay for what you use
Published example prices per model and per hardware type
limitations: A free tier and a minimum spend are not stated on the page we read
Private models are billed for all time an instance is online, including idle time

plans.name: Public models
plans.note: Billed mostly by run time, some by input and output. Examples: flux-schnell $3.00 per thousand output images; flux-dev $0.025 per output image; flux-1.1-pro $0.04 per output image

plans.name: Hardware (private models and fine-tunes)
plans.note: Per second of use. Examples: cpu $0.000100 per second ($0.36 per hour); gpu-t4 $0.000225 per second ($0.81 per hour); gpu-a100-large $0.001400 per second ($5.04 per hour); gpu-h100 $0.001525 per second ($5.49 per hour)

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.note: Dedicated account manager, higher GPU limits and committed-spend capacity are arranged through sales

api.summary: Example per-run prices: deepseek-r1 $3.75 per million input tokens and $0.01 per thousand output tokens; ideogram-v3-quality $0.09 per output image; wan-2.1-i2v-480p $0.09 per second of output video.

pricing.regional: Prices are shown in USD with a '$' sign. Tax and regional pricing: not stated.

verification.notes: Product active. Pay-as-you-go: most models billed by run time on the hardware used, some per input and output (flux-1.1-pro $0.04 per image, flux-dev $0.025, flux-schnell $3.00 per thousand images, deepseek-r1 $3.75 per million input tokens). No subscription tiers; enterprise by sales. Hardware per-second rates were not re-read.
verification.method: Opened in the Claude desktop built-in browser; page text read

profile.headline: Run, fine-tune and deploy machine-learning models with one API call

capabilities.title: Run thousands of public models
capabilities.text: Use community-published models, such as image models, through a single API call.

capabilities.title: Fine-tune a model on your data
capabilities.text: Train an existing model to produce a specific style or subject.

capabilities.title: Deploy your own model
capabilities.text: Package it with Cog, the open-source packaging tool, and Replicate builds an API server and runs it in the cloud.

capabilities.title: Scale automatically
capabilities.text: The platform scales up with traffic and down to zero when there is none.
